title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Hong Kong retiree loses $840K in triple ‘crypto expert’ scam
summary: Hong Kong police say a 66-year-old retiree was duped three times in six months by self-styled “crypto investment experts,” as scammers promised easy gains and help to recover losses.

title: Bitcoin mining difficulty falls 7.7% as miner pressure persists
summary: Bitcoin’s mining difficulty just logged its second sizeable cut of 2026, easing conditions for remaining miners as competition from artificial intelligence data centers rises.

title: Early Ethereum whale rebuilds stack with $19.5M in ETH buys
summary: Early Ethereum whale thomasg.eth is rebuilding his position with $19.5 million in ETH purchases this week, as BitMine’s Tom Lee calls for the end of “crypto winter.”

title: Bitcoin weakness deepens as war pushes traders to cut risk in BTC and stocks
summary: Bitcoin price remains rocky, and BTC and equities ETF outflows soar as the US and Israel-Iran war enters a fourth week.

title: Gold sees biggest weekly fall in 43 years as Iran war rages on
summary: Gold is also being impacted by rising anticipation that the US Federal Reserve won’t cut interest rates this year, while Fed chair Jerome Powell said inflation would rise.

title: Grayscale files S-1 for Hyperliquid ETF, joining Bitwise, 21Shares
summary: Unlike Bitwise, Grayscale doesn’t plan to incorporate staking for its Hyperliquid ETF but hasn’t ruled out integrating it in the future.

title: Rumors emerge of a CLARITY Act deal between White House and lawmakers
summary: The deal reportedly focuses on stablecoin yield and interest-bearing stable tokens, a major pain point for the banking industry.

title: Bitcoin price aims to hold $70K amid rising inflation concerns
summary: Bitcoin searches for equilibrium at $70,000 while rising crude oil prices and tanking stock markets have investors worried over the future of inflation in the US.

title: Google Threat Intel flags 'Ghostblade' crypto-stealing malware
summary: Ghostblade is one of six malware tools in the "DarkSword" suite of malicious software designed to steal crypto private keys and user data.
